purpose: Public DISL ARCOS near-real-time hydrographic and meteorological observations for Jubilee research/current-state context. All stations remain zero production weight until separate promotion.
guardrails: Public Grafana values are direct observations at the named ARCOS station, but are not automatically Eastern Shore shoreline/contact-strip or bottom measurements.
The dashboard depth field is water-level/depth context; it is not accepted as sonde height above bed or proof of bottom placement.
A zero or missing depth value must remain UNKNOWN_GEOMETRY, never be converted into bottom-DO identity.

Current Grafana frames do not expose the historical aggregate QC flag per row; apply DISL published physical range screens and freshness, preserve SOURCE_QC_NOT_EXPOSED, and keep production weight zero.
Missing or stale station data are UNKNOWN, not zero and not negative Jubilee evidence.

Historical literature can establish past sensor geometry (including ~0.5 m above bottom at MP/BS/DI and Katrina Cut), but production/current-state bottom identity requires current deployment continuity or current metadata.
Meteorological variables are ingested from the same ARCOS station network as contextual forcing; they are not independent of other weather stations merely because the parameter is duplicated.
ARCOS bar_pressure1 is treated as inches of mercury in the US dashboard/source parameter documentation; do not relabel raw values as mbar without conversion.
Hydrographic pressure is ingested in PSI because it is an official ARCOS parameter even though the public station dashboard does not graph it.
